cues: Because the two limbs run in opposite directions, a small difference at each level is multiplied down the loop.
The medulla builds a gradient from three hundred at the cortex to twelve hundred milliosmoles at the tip.
The vasa recta run counter current too, so the blood does not wash the salt away.
text: Because the two limbs run in opposite directions, a small difference at each level is multiplied down the loop. The medulla builds a gradient from three hundred at the cortex to twelve hundred milliosmoles at the tip. The vasa recta run counter current too, so the blood does not wash the salt away.
